description: This source file defines the EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI class, which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing employee attendance records including listing, creating, updating (punching in/out), and deleting attendance records within an HR management system.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: API controller class providing endpoints for employee attendance record management, including listing, creating, updating (punch-in/out), and deleting attendance records, with validation, permission checks, and integration with attendance services.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list attendance records for an employee, supporting filtering by date range, sorting, and pagination, and returns data along with total count and working time sum.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new punch-in attendance record for an employee, checking permissions, overlapping records, and saving the record with accurate timestamps.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified attendance records for an employee, with permission validation to prevent unauthorized deletions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to fetch a single attendance record detail.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to punch out an employee's attendance record, including permission checks, overlap validation, and updating the record with punch-out details.
